description: The file defines the HttpViewHandler class, which extends AbstractViewHandler and manages rendering HTTP views by fetching and outputting external web pages.

classes.name: HttpViewHandler
classes.description: A class responsible for handling HTTP-based view rendering, extending AbstractViewHandler and implementing the render logic by fetching and delivering external web page content.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the view handler with the given servlet context. Currently empty.

methods.name: prepareViewContext
methods.description: Prepares the view context, returning an empty map in this implementation.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Fetches content from a specified URL using HttpClient and writes it to the HTTP response. Throws a ViewHandlerException on errors.
